intent: Extend the existing CAP-0003 semantic catalog so mainstream digital-storage quantities can be represented, normalized and compared without ad-hoc unit additions or case-folding ambiguity. Preserve exact canonical symbols for SI decimal and IEC binary units, add explicit aliases only where they are unambiguous, reuse core.unit_conversion_versions as a sparse authoritative conversion graph, derive inverse/transitive conversions in the runtime snapshot, and fail closed on ambiguous aliases, cross-dimension edges or inconsistent conversion paths. Keep CAP-0007 as the execution owner and resume the TrendForce Evidence cursor after this bounded semantic-infrastructure repair.
rationale_summary: The first source-grounded storage-volume Reality correctly exposed a missing EB unit. A one-off EB row is sufficient for that historical fact but not for durable storage research: decimal TB/PB/EB, binary TiB/PiB/EiB and bit-oriented telecom/storage quantities must remain distinguishable, while the current runtime lower-cases canonical unit codes and therefore cannot safely admit byte/bit symbols that differ by case. The repository already owns versioned unit conversion rows and semantic-runtime fingerprinting, so this change extends those existing owners instead of introducing a parallel units subsystem. The persistent design is exact canonical symbols plus explicit aliases, sparse same-dimension conversion edges, runtime graph closure and consistency checks, with unknown or ambiguous unit text preserved for review rather than guessed.
